purpose: Start a race-closed full reread of one record type after its established baseline loses change-token continuity: request a fresh pre-read changes token, then durably commit it with a new Reconciliation Snapshot identity through begin-initial-snapshot@2's primitive, superseding and retaining the attempt the caller names, before any page is read, or begin nothing.

inputs.name: record_type
inputs.description: One record type name from project-source-record's PROJECTION_SCHEMA_VERSIONS.

inputs.name: sender_installation
inputs.description: The lowercase UUID of the Sender's own active Sender Installation, supplied by the caller.

inputs.name: superseding
inputs.description: The identity of the record type's current snapshot attempt, whose change-token continuity the caller has found lost.

inputs.name: snapshot_identity_source
inputs.description: A source of random lowercase version 4 UUIDs, one of which becomes the new Reconciliation Snapshot identity.

inputs.name: current_time
inputs.description: The commit time, read once inside the commit transaction after its recheck.

inputs.name: health_connect_token
inputs.description: The changes token and unread-since instant begin-initial-snapshot's Kotlin issuer reports for the record type, including its permission and failure classification.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: the record type's current snapshot attempt and that attempt's page-chain progress, read before the token request and again inside the commit transaction.

outputs.name: reconciliation_begun
outputs.description: The new Reconciliation Snapshot identity, record type, fresh changes token, and unread-since instant committed durably as the record type's current attempt with empty page-chain state, with the superseded attempt retained and marked abandoned.

outputs.name: refusal
outputs.description: A named reason the current attempt cannot be superseded by a reconciliation, with nothing written. A refusal found before the token request requests no token, and one found by the commit's recheck discards the token it was issued.

outputs.name: not_permitted
outputs.description: Which required permission was missing, read or history, or that Health Connect denied the request, with nothing written.

outputs.name: read_failure
outputs.description: One named Health Connect failure with no exception text and nothing written.

outputs.name: storage_failure
outputs.description: A read or the commit failed and rolled back, so nothing was begun.

observable_effects.name: health-connect-token-request
observable_effects.description: Requests one changes token through begin-initial-snapshot's issuer only after the pre-checks pass; never reads records or changes.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Commits the new Reconciliation Snapshot attempt, its current pointer, and the superseded attempt's abandonment in one SQLite transaction through begin-initial-snapshot@2's primitive, or not at all; owns no table and no migration.

owns: the preconditions for beginning a Reconciliation Snapshot: the caller names the current attempt, it belongs to the same Sender Installation, and the record type has an established page chain
the Reconciliation Snapshot's pre-read changes token and unread-since instant, and its identity issuance
classification of the token issuer's outcomes and storage failures into the named failures for a reconciliation
does_not_own: the snapshot-attempt tables, the one-current-attempt rule, and supersession, which belong to begin-initial-snapshot
deciding that change-token continuity was lost or that the Portal holds an established baseline, which belongs to coordinate-sender-sync
the Kotlin token request and its permission checks, which belong to begin-initial-snapshot
reading pages, page-chain progress, and Outbox Messages, which belong to read-snapshot-page and stage-outbox-batch
Reconciliation Snapshot completion and cutover, which belong to stage-sync-completion and complete-reconciliation-snapshot
the Expo bridge between Kotlin and TypeScript
